description: GNSS data of ambient vibrations and artificial excitations of the Aaresteg bridge. is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Yara Rossi, John Clinton (ETH Zürich). GNSS Data: - Instrument: Java GrAnt-G3T antenna and Septentrio PolaRx receiver - sampling rate: 20 Hz - Bandwidth of loop filter: auto adjust - Date: 2021-09-27 Location: Instrument was set up on the eastern railing of the Aaresteg bridge, 1.125 m height above the wooden planks. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
